info.name: Lugn & Trygg - Integration API
info.description: E2E test collection for third-party integration routes (src/routes/integration_routes.py). Covers OAuth 2.0 connect/callback/status/disconnect for wearable providers, OAuth-backed and legacy mock health data sync, health-mood analytics, deprecated wearable endpoints, not-yet-implemented FHIR endpoints, crisis referral creation, comprehensive multi-source health sync, auto-sync scheduler settings, health alert generation/settings, and negative paths (no auth, invalid provider, missing body fields). All bodies use clearly neutral, benign language — nothing resembling real self-harm/crisis text is submitted.
